plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Art - Studio Art A.A. Degree - CalGETC' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published August 19, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/8019/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 66 = 15+18+18+15 (all semester headers match their rows; verified). List A - Art History (minimum 6 units): ARTH C1100, ARTH 309 (advisory ENGL C1000), ARTH 311, ARTH 312, ARTH 328, ARTH 332 (advisory ENGL C1000), ARTH 333 — one 3-unit selection sequenced in each of Semesters 2 and 4 (map recommends ARTH 309 for Semester 2, ARTH 311 for Semester 4); a different course per slot. List B - Studio (minimum 12 units): ART 301, ART 302 (requires ART 300), ART 305 (requires ART 304), ART 312, ART 324, ART 327 (advisory ART 300), ART 328 (requires ART 327), ART 330, ART 336, ART 337 (requires ART 336), ART 338, ART 361, ART 362, ART 364, ART 372, ART 402, ART 404 (requires ART 402), ART 443 (enrollment limitation: 2 college art courses from ART or ARTH), ARTNM 324 (advisory: ART 300, ART 320, CISC 302 or JOUR 330), ARTNM 420 (advisory: ART 320 & 370) — one 3-unit selection in Semester 2, two in Semester 3, one in Semester 4; a different course per slot. Full 20-course List B in choice_notes; option arrays capped at 10 entries. Semester 3 ceramics choice: ART 394 (Beginning), ART 395 (Intermediate), or ART 396 (Advanced) Wheel Thrown Ceramics. Semester 4 'CalGETC Area 7C-Lab' row carries GE AREA 5C (typo; encoded 5C). Semester 4 elective (2 units): units needed to total 60 units for graduation; refer to Course Number for the appropriate course level. CalGETC Areas 1A and 2: map recommends meeting with a counselor.
